items.title: The repository typecheck is red at this tip: three type errors in tests/card/actions/write-path-races.test.ts
items.assignment:
Fix GitHub issue 20 in KatsuJinCode/decko-ts: "The repository typecheck is red at this tip: three type errors in tests/card/actions/write-path-races.test.ts".

Work in /data/home/decko-ts. Read its AGENTS.md first and follow it. Make the branch port/instabox-issue-20 from origin/deploy/full-candidate-20261104 (the port's working line; main is the old work board). Touch only that branch; other agents work on other branches. Nothing is ever sent or shown to anyone outside this repository.

The issue, in full:

What happened.

`npm run typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit`) fails at the tip of `port/smell-test-round2-20261024` (commit 9658a462, the parent of this lane's work) with three errors, all in one file that the lane did not touch:

```
tests/card/actions/write-path-races.test.ts(132,3): error TS2322: Type '(string | null)[]' is not assignable to type 'string[]'.
tests/card/actions/write-path-races.test.ts(526,15): error TS2722: Cannot invoke an object which is possibly 'undefined'.
tests/card/actions/write-path-races.test.ts(526,15): error TS18048: 'driver.transaction' is possibly 'undefined'.
```

`git diff 9658a462..HEAD -- tests/card/actions/write-path-races.test.ts` is empty, so the failing file is exactly the one at the base tip, and no file the lane added produces a typecheck error.

What it costs.

Every lane that adds a TypeScript file and then runs the typecheck has to separate its own errors from these three before it can claim a clean typecheck, and the project's own gate (`node tools/test-gates.mjs check`) is red for a reason unrelated to whatever the lane is doing. A red typecheck at the tip also hides a real error added later in the same file's neighbourhood.

How it could be better.

Fix the three errors in `tests/card/actions/write-path-races.test.ts` (the `string | null` element at line 132, and the possibly-undefined `driver.transaction` at line 526), so the typecheck is green at the tip again and a lane's own typecheck result is a statement about the lane.

Reproduction: `npx tsc --noEmit` in a checkout of `port/smell-test-round2-20261024` at 9658a462 or later.

Commit only the files you changed with git commit -m "<message>" -- <paths>, through any commit hook (never --no-verify), and push only your branch: git push origin port/instabox-issue-20. Open no pull request. This is a Linux machine; the product may also ship on Windows, so do not change behaviour a Windows run depends on without saying so, and name any test you could not run here.

Report back in plain English: what you changed, the test results with counts, anything you could not verify on this machine, and the pushed commit.

items.title: add an added-lines em-dash gate to the correctness gate
items.assignment:

The issue, in full:

What happened: the register-rows fixes lane (port/regfix-3-20261025) carries a brief guard of no em-dashes in added lines; the guard was enforced only by a post-hoc scan, and the lane landed two row commits before the scan caught six comment lines with em-dashes (fixed in a502a6b9, rebuilding pre-existing lines byte-verbatim via difflib opcodes against the base).

What it cost: a follow-up commit and a rebuild risk on files other lanes share.

How it could be better: a check in tools/test-gates.mjs's correctness gate (or scripts/release-check.mjs) that diffs the working tree against the merge-base and fails on added lines carrying em/en-dashes, the same shape as the existing first-cell backtick check reading KNOWN_FAILURES.md. The lane briefs carry the guard today; a mechanical gate would make the discipline load-bearing.

items.title: the search-for-a-nonexistent-name check grades a page-wide token and is satisfied by the navbar chrome
items.assignment:
Fix GitHub issue 19 in KatsuJinCode/decko-ts: "the search-for-a-nonexistent-name check grades a page-wide token and is satisfied by the navbar chrome".

Work in /data/home/decko-ts. Read its AGENTS.md first and follow it. Make the branch port/instabox-issue-19 from origin/deploy/full-candidate-20261104 (the port's working line; main is the old work board). Touch only that branch; other agents work on other branches. Nothing is ever sent or shown to anyone outside this repository.

The issue, in full:

WHAT HAPPENED

The check "search for a nonexistent name offers a create link"
(`tools/edge-signed-in-exercise.mjs:1009-1014`) grades a PAGE-WIDE token test:

    const hasCreate = /create|new card|\/new\//i.test(body);

`body` is the whole page HTML. A named-instrument probe of the same page
(local stack booted by the exercise's own helpers, the engine's own sign-in
endpoint, the search page answering 200 with 18,888 bytes) counted five token
contexts on that page. Four of them are ONE navbar dropdown item: the deck's
own Opportunities list carries a link chunk labelled "New Card", and the
navbar renders it as a dropdown item with an add_box icon, so its slot data,
its anchor and its icon-plus-title all carry the token. The fifth is the
page's own inline SVG comment ("Created with Sketch").

THE MECHANISM

Ruby's own view for a search that matched nothing is an EMPTY div
(`card-mod-search-0.20.0/set/abstract/0_search/views.rb:126-128`,
`view :no_search_results` -> `wrap_with :div, "", class: "search-no-results"`).
So the search RESULTS offer nothing, and the token the predicate finds is
navbar chrome that every signed-in page carries.

WHAT IT COST

The check's name promises that the search page offers a create link for the
name that was searched for. What it proves is that the page contains a
create-ish token somewhere. The matrix tranche of 2026-10-24 (branch
port/matrix-round8-20261024, receipt docs/reports/row-mx-B-033-create-card-group-2026-10-24.md)
had to name this limit in the row's adjudication, and the row's oracle
evidence for it is the search chain rather than a create affordance.

HOW IT COULD BE BETTER

Grade the surface the name promises: read the search RESULTS region (the
`div.search-result-list` or the `div.search-no-results` the port serves) and
ask whether IT carries a create affordance for the searched name, rather
than asking whether the whole page contains the word. If the product does
not offer a create link on a no-results search, then the check should say so
and the row should be named for what it measures.
